heroStrategy.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
heroStrategy.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) — advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
heroStrategy.designNote: Use a dark, premium hero with the headline on the left and an oversized layered product montage centered-right, letting the media bleed behind a subtle overlay instead of using a standard split. The hero visual should combine a mock AI interface, a prompt input strip, an image output tile, and a video preview card with a visible play state to communicate both image and video generation immediately. Add thin precision grid lines, orange edge glows, and soft shadowed cards to reinforce enterprise-grade control. Keep the CTA in ByteDance orange, large and rounded, with the trust chips integrated directly beneath the supporting copy.

repetitionBreakers: Start with a dark split hero, then switch immediately to a light trust strip so the first scroll feels high-contrast and not repetitive.
Use a compact logo marquee first, then a visual-heavy 3-step process, then a proof band with metrics/logos, then a spotlight-plus-grid product block to avoid same-pattern stacking.
Alternate backgrounds across every adjacent section: dark hero, light trust, white process, dark proof, white feature, dark pricing, light testimonials, dark final form.
Make the first product block image-led and the second one accordion-led so the two product sections do not feel cloned.
blueprint.pageTitle: Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro by ByteDance | AI Images & Videos
blueprint.metaDescription: Create high-quality AI images and videos with ByteDance’s Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro. Explore the 3-step workflow, trusted logos, key features, pricing, testimonials, and get started.

sections.backgroundTreatment: dark premium shell with thin precision lines, subtle orange glow, and layered product thumbnails
sections.designNote: Hero must match warm-ad continuity and answer all three questions fast: what it is, who it is for, and what to do next. Use the existing product headline in a tightened form, keep the subheadline audience-specific, and make the right side dynamic with an image-and-video composite showing prompt chips, output tiles, and a play-state preview. CTA must be a single solid orange button labeled exactly 'Get started'. This is hero-product dominant, but content still leads clarity.

Place trust early and keep it prominent because the trust strategy is logos-first. Use 3-6 recognisable logos in a compact marquee band; if logo assets are unavailable, fall back to a metric strip. Keep it short and visually efficient so it feels like credibility, not a section that slows the page.

Warm traffic sequence requires a 3-step process under 60 seconds. Make this a bright, easy-scanning section with three large steps: enter prompt or asset, generate with Seedream or Seedance, refine and export. Use a simple progression line, large numerals, and one compact visual on the right showing fast workflow motion. Keep density moderate and friction low.

Make proof immediate and industry-relevant. Since proof type is logos, use an elevated dark proof band with logo row plus a slim supporting strip of credibility statements. If the logos are limited, pair with a metric strip. This section should feel authoritative and premium, not promotional.

This is the main feature block and should focus only on the click-driving capability: Seedream 4.5 image generation. Because there are 5+ features, use a spotlight-plus-grid layout with one dominant preview panel and a supporting 4-5 feature grid. Emphasize text-to-image, 4K output, typographic rendering, multi-image composition, and identity preservation. Make this section bright, crisp, and more product-specific than generic.

featurePresentation.primaryFeatureTitle: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro

sections.designNote: Second product block must feel distinctly different from the first. Use a dark background and an accordion-with-visual layout to showcase Seedance 1.5 Pro in a more cinematic way, with one large motion preview and stacked feature accordions. Highlight audio-video sync, lip-sync, cinematic camera control, text-to-video, and speed. This section should feel immersive and motion-led.

Keep pricing clear but not overpowering. Use two product cards with the Seedance plan slightly more visually elevated because it has a visible starting price, while Seedream stays quote-led. The CTA on every card must still read exactly 'Get started'. Avoid visual clutter; the goal is decision support, not a dense comparison table.

Since there are 4+ testimonials, use a carousel. Keep it polished and concise with role-first identification so Creative Director, Video Producer, Art Director, and Marketing Manager feel credible. This section should lean into creative-team trust and visibly support the premium tone without repeating the logo proof pattern.

Final conversion section should be direct and low-friction, with a floating form card over a dark background. Use strong contrast, minimal fields, and one full-width mobile CTA labeled exactly 'Get started'. The supporting copy should say 'See it in action' rather than 'Sign up now' in tone, but the button text must remain unchanged. Keep this as the most decisive CTA area on the page.

blueprint.designPersonality: Premium enterprise AI with a dark, high-contrast brand shell, orange-led confidence, logo-first credibility, and visually intelligent product storytelling built around precision, speed, and multimodal creative output.
blueprint.imageryDirection: Use a layered product-led visual on the right side of the hero: abstract AI interface shells, floating prompt chips, output thumbnails, and a cinematic video preview panel with a visible play state. Add a dedicated gallery section containing video, with one large video card and two supporting preview tiles. Logos should dominate trust sections through SVG brand bands, partner rows, and enterprise proof strips. Use subtle orange glow edges, thin precision lines, and soft shadow cards to keep the page intelligent and premium without drifting into generic gradient AI styling.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is 16+ words, so it needs a smaller hero size to preserve hierarchy and avoid awkward wraps in a premium two-column composition.

colours.colourReason: The brand palette is derived exclusively from techjockey.com brand colors. Orange is the primary CTA and hero color, black creates the dark premium shell, white keeps cards and content readable, and soft grey provides separation without introducing any outside colors.

referenceMap.heroPattern: Simple split-friendly brand hero with logo placement above a bold centered headline, concise supporting copy, and a short list of benefit bullets using tick icons; primary conversion focus is immediate and above the fold.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Single large hero block followed by a lead-capture form section, then product/feature content blocks; low-complexity page rhythm with strong vertical separation rather than dense multi-column storytelling.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Functional form card and content blocks with minimal decorative treatment; compact, bordered, utility-first card feel rather than glassmorphism or elevated marketing cards.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: One dominant primary CTA in the hero and one supporting CTA in the form section; CTA strategy is conversion-led and sparse, with no persistent sticky bar or multi-CTA overload.
referenceMap.footerMode: Not present in the provided reference.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Logo-led hero with no prominent product imagery in the visible reference; media usage is minimal and utility-oriented rather than immersive or cinematic.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Feature sections are structured as stacked informational modules with headline, short description, and bullet-style capability lists; suited to progressive disclosure and long-form B2B explanation.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead form section immediately after the hero, presented as a full-width conversion block with a titled card and multiple hidden tracking fields; optimized for lead capture rather than checkout.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, low-motion presentation with no visible animated transitions in the reference markup.
componentPatterns: benefit bullet list with icon markers
designNotes: B2B landing page optimized for lead generation and clarity over visual experimentation.
Content hierarchy favors concise claims and structured support details.
The layout appears mobile-aware with explicit line-break control for responsive headline rendering.
Use simple, high-contrast CTA buttons and compact section spacing for a similar reusable pattern.

blueprint.brandSiteName: Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro by ByteDance
blueprint.additionalInstructions:
PROOF STRATEGY: The visitor trusts logos most. Make this the dominant trust signal.

use dark theme, add gallery section containing video

mustHaveMoments: Logo-led trust strip placed prominently above or directly adjacent to the hero headline
Dark-themed hero with a clear split layout: value proposition on one side, visual/product proof on the other
Gallery section featuring video outputs to demonstrate Seedance capabilities
Dedicated image-generation feature block for Seedream with concise capability bullets
Dedicated video-generation feature block with audio-sync and cinematic controls highlighted
Enterprise-ready proof cues and lightweight testimonial reinforcement near conversion points
Clear demo-oriented CTA placement after the hero and after major feature sections
avoidPatterns: Overly decorative or playful visual language that weakens enterprise credibility
Long-form dense paragraphs without scannable proof points
CTA overload with too many competing actions
Light-theme or high-whitespace aesthetic that reduces the requested dark, premium feel
Generic stock imagery that does not show actual AI image/video outputs
Pricing-first framing since the page goal is demo booking and evaluation
designStrategy.reasoning: This page should behave like a high-intent product evaluation landing page for enterprise and creative buyers who already understand generative AI. The strongest conversion lever is proof, especially logos, so the design should foreground trust instantly and repeatedly. Because the content includes both image and video models, the page needs a product-led structure with a dark premium look, a split hero, and a visible gallery/video demonstration section to make the capabilities tangible. The CTA strategy should stay focused on demo booking rather than purchase friction, with moderate urgency and clear placement after the hero and feature sections. Overall, the page should feel futuristic, credible, and efficient while keeping the information easy to scan.

strengths: Design planned from strategy and intent layers
